name: What is the typical process for a custom cabinet or built-in project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a custom cabinet or built-in project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom cabinet or built-in project typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. This is followed by detailed measurements of the space and the creation of design plans and renderings for your approval. Once the design is finalized, materials are sourced, and the custom pieces are fabricated off-site in a workshop. The installation phase involves delivering and meticulously fitting the built-ins or cabinets into your home. This process ensures a perfect fit and finish tailored to your specific requirements and space.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, detailed measurements, design approval, off-site fabrication, and meticulous on-site installation of the custom pieces.
